Jan '''"Peppe"''' Piechal is a Swedish Quakeworld player, perhaps more known as an admin and crew member of recent iterations of [[QHLAN]]. In recent years he's been spotted more and more as guest caster in various shows, when not streaming on [https://www.twitch.tv/Peppe_qw his own channel].

As a player Peppe fears no man, although his aggressive and sometimes mindless play style cost him games.
